title.en: Classic Shaman Discord Open Again After 13 Hours
title.es: Classic Chamán Discord vuelve a abrir después de 13 horas

summary.en: Classic Shaman Discord Open Again After 13 Hours...
summary.es: Classic Chamán Discord se abre de nuevo después de 13 horas...

contentHtml:
After almost 13 hours, the Classic Shaman Discord has reopened, allowing all players to chat in its channels once again.

Earlier today at around 1:37 AM PST, the Classic Shaman Discord closed down, preventing players from posting in any channels. Citing "how the developers are approaching all shaman specs in WoW Forever", they listed a list of design issues that they felt were against the fundamental design and class feel of Shamans.

As of 2:28 PM PST, after almost 13 hours, the Discord is open once again and players can chat there to prepare for the WoW: Forever launch.
Doors are open again. You didn't think we'd seriously close the Discord for Forever's launch did you?
WoW: Forever launches in just over 24 hours with no listed tuning changes since the Development notes yesterday.

title.en: You Can Play WoW: Forever on a Gamepad
title.es: Puedes jugar WoW: Forever en un Gamepad

summary.en: You Can Play WoW: Forever on a Gamepad...
summary.es: Puedes jugar WoW: Forever en un Gamepad...

contentHtml:
World of Warcraft: Forever officially supports playing with a Gamepad and Blizzard breaks down everything you need to know.
Blizzard
View Original
A spell to cast, an ally to heal, a well-earned reward to collect—there’s plenty to keep you busy in Azeroth. If you prefer a gamepad, World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another way to join the action.

In World of Warcraft: Forever, we’ve refined targeting, casting, looting, and menu navigation for gamepads while keeping the familiar feel players have come to know.

Get to Know Your Gamepad Experience


WoW: Forever supports all XInput-compatible controllers and includes Xbox and PlayStation button icons to help you recognize the controls.

Switch to Gamepad Controls

Press Escape to open the Game Menu, select Options, then choose Gamepad under Gameplay to switch from keyboard-and-mouse input.

Make the experience your own in the Gamepad settings. You can adjust Camera, HUD Modifier, Frame Focus Style, Action Bars, Targeting, and Raid Targeting Options.

Just as you arrange spells and abilities on your action bars, take a little time to set up your gamepad controls around the abilities you use. Try a layout that feels comfortable, then adjust it as you learn new spells or change how you play.
A little faction pride, right in your hands!

On controllers with supported lighting, the light turns red for a Horde character and blue for an Alliance character.
Take a little time to try moving, selecting targets, and using your abilities before heading into a busy fight.

Put the Controls to Work

Here’s a quick guide to moving, choosing targets, using abilities, and navigating menus with a gamepad. We’re using Xbox button names to describe these controls.
  • Move and look around: Move your character with the left stick and adjust the camera with the right stick.
  • Select a target: Use the left bumper (LB) for a friendly target or the right bumper (RB) for a hostile target.
  • Interact and navigate: The controller map lists X for Interact, A for Jump, B for Back, and Y for Inspect. These buttons also have spell functions.
  • Switch action bars: Hold LT, RT, or both triggers together to access different action bars. Release the triggers to return to your default action bar.
  • Open menus and change focus: The Menu button opens the Main Menu. The View button, marked with overlapping squares, is listed as Change Focus Frame.
The heads-up display, or HUD, uses several panels arranged to mirror a gamepad’s layout, helping you connect your abilities with the controls in your hands.

More Abilities, Familiar Buttons

The gamepad HUD shows four action bars. Each uses the same button layout but can hold a different set of spells and abilities. Hold LT, RT, or LT + RT to switch bars, and release the triggers to return to the default bar. The HUD updates to show the abilities available on your active bar.

For example, a Mage could assign four spells to the same directional button:
  • Up: Polymorph (Sheep)
  • LT + Up: Fireball
  • RT + Up: Frostbolt
  • LT + RT + Up: Blizzard
These are example assignments, not fixed bindings—choose the spells and abilities that suit you.

Organize Your Action Bar Sets

Want separate layouts for combat, utility abilities, or frequently used actions? You can switch between three action bar sets by holding LB + RB and pressing Left or Right on the directional pad (D-pad).

Each set contains four action bars with 28 slots combined, giving you 84 customizable spell and ability slots across all three sets. The button layout stays consistent as you switch sets, so you can reach different groups of abilities without opening menus.

Reach Your HUD with Shortcuts

Hold both shoulder buttons (LB + RB), then press the following buttons to access frequently used HUD elements:
  • LB + RB + B: Open Backpack
  • LB + RB + Up: Access Quest Tracker
  • LB + RB + Down: Access Chat
  • LB + RB + Y: Manage Buffs
You can also access these features through the main radial menu. The shortcuts let you reach them directly with your gamepad; typing in chat still requires a keyboard.

Find Your Controls at a Glance

A gamepad legend sits in the upper-left corner of the main screen. It expands when you take certain actions to show additional options.

Most screens also include gamepad footers that show the interaction options for each panel. Not every screen has a footer yet: gamepad support remains in a functional beta, and interface updates are ongoing.

Built for the Adventures You Share

Tanking, healing, and dealing damage all call for selecting the right target at the right moment. Friendly and hostile targeting controls help you choose allies and enemies as you play with your party.

A Familiar World, a Reworked Interface

The gamepad HUD uses a layout built around the controls in your hands. Beyond combat, interface updates are ongoing to make bags and menus easier to navigate with a gamepad.

The Journey Continues

Controller support is available in WoW: Forever in a beta state for players who prefer a gamepad. Further refinements are planned as work on the experience continues.

Reducing the need for keyboard input remains a development goal, with a keyboard-free experience as the longer-term aim. For now, keep a keyboard within reach for tasks such as typing in-game chat.

Ready your gamepad and gather your party. Try the controls, adjust the settings to suit you, and enjoy a little time in Azeroth together.

title.en: Tier Pieces Require Quest Chain That Requires Group Content in WoW: Forever
title.es: Las piezas de nivel requieren una cadena de búsqueda que requiere contenido de grupo en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Tier Pieces Require Quest Chain That Requires Group Content in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Las piezas de nivel requieren una cadena de búsqueda que requiere contenido de grupo en WoW: para siempre...

contentHtml:
During the WoW: Forever Launch overview, Blizzard revealed that Tier Tokens will unlock a series of quests that ends with the player earning a Tier Piece.

Forever Tier Set Overview


In the Forever Launch Overview video, the final section discusses raids and what to expect. Raids will once again drop Tier pieces which include bonuses for equipping multiple pieces of the same set. When talking about Tier Tokens, Blizzard revealed some details about how Tier Tokens will work.
Vanquish the raid bosses, and you'll be able to claim rewards that far exceed what you've come across previously. Acquire a Tier Token and you'll open a new adventure for you or any other ally lucky enough to claim their prize. With these rewards, you'll need to seek out how to start a quest that ends with an adventurer earning a Tier Piece, one of the greatest items one can acquire for their given class. Much like dungeons and raids, you won't be able to complete these quests completely on your own. So keep in close touch with your fellow adventurers so that you all can achieve new heights of power.
From this description, getting your Tier Piece looks to be more involved and will require multiple quests, with the first step being getting a Tier Token. Once you have a Tier Token, there appears to be an involved quest line with some steps requiring group content.

The D&D: World of Warcraft bundles are now in early access, and that means players who preordered them can earn their in-game goodies for Retail WoW.

Announced in July, the D&D: World of Warcraft bundles bring Azeroth to your Friday night games in a new way, with new rules for Warcraft classes, playable species, new spells, new monsters, and more. While the bundles officially release on November 17, early access for them begins today, so players can start to claim their in-game rewards: the Black Malice black dragon mount, the Eyestalker Beholder pet, and a Mimic-themed toy and decor!

title.en: What's New and What's the Same in WoW: Forever
title.es: Qué hay de nuevo y qué es lo mismo en WoW: Forever

summary.en: What's New and What's the Same in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Qué hay de nuevo y qué es lo mismo en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a blog highlighting what's new and what will feel the same in WoW: Forever, whether you play modern, Classic or haven't played for a while.
Blizzard
View Original
From a well-fought battle to a look that feels uniquely yours, the moments that matter in WoW are personal. World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another setting for those interests, whether you play the modern game, prefer Classic, haven’t logged in for a while, or are getting to know Warcraft for the first time.

If you play the modern game, some elements will feel familiar, while others take a different approach. Here’s a look at the controls, content, and character choices that can help you decide what you’d like to try.

Controls and Conveniences

Experience Presets bundle the game’s initial visual and interface settings into two options: Classic and Enhanced. The choice affects presentation, not which Ruleset you play on. Individual settings remain adjustable in Game Menu > Options.

Enhanced puts several conveniences within easy reach for players accustomed to modern WoW:
  • Quest guidance: Points of interest and marked objective areas help you find where to go next.
  • One-bag view: See your inventory together rather than opening each bag separately.
  • Transmog: Keep character appearance part of your adventure.
  • Movement and layout: Start with keyboard bindings for strafing and a centralized screen layout.
  • Character visuals: Begin with high-definition character models.
Classic starts with standard-definition character models, a classic screen layout, and keyboard bindings for camera turning. Quest guidance, one-bag view, and transmog are turned off by default. You can favor that presentation without giving up the option to adjust individual settings. The preset names describe defaults, not player skill.

For more information during combat, Advanced options in WoW: Forever provide access to elements such as the Cooldown Manager and a Damage Meter. Alongside the preset settings, these tools give you more ways to configure your interface around how you play.

A controller offers another way to explore, use your abilities, and play with a group. In WoW: Forever, you can use a gamepad to select allies and enemies, cast spells, collect loot, and navigate menus. Gamepad support is available in a beta state, with more improvements to come. You’ll still need a keyboard for tasks such as chat.

More to Explore at Levels 1–60

The Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor provide the setting for leveling to 60. New and expanded zones, quests, and character options build on original WoW’s foundation, giving explorers more to investigate across these continents, but sticks to a level cap of 60 without going beyond. This leaves room for an expanding game without an expansion of levels.

Nine new five-player dungeons cover levels 13 through 60, adding threats and quests throughout the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. For players who enjoy working through encounters with a party, that means new group content to seek out during leveling and at the level cap.

The Skyborne add another perspective as a new playable race with a starting experience on Zephras Isle. At character creation, choose Horde-aligned Windshaper Skyborne or Alliance-aligned High Order Skyborne. Story fans can get to know these people through their own unique introduction.

Same Class, Familiar Races, Different Toolkit

A familiar class name is a starting point, not a guarantee of the same build or combat rhythm you use in the modern game. Here, classes are revisited with talent and ability updates rooted in original WoW, giving you another way to explore their identities.

Hunters, for example, can use traps in combat, and their pets gain definition through gear scaling and unique family abilities. If you already enjoy adventuring with a companion, these changes offer a reason to get to know your Hunter again. Read your abilities, try different tools, and leave room for discoveries rather than expecting your approach in the modern game to be an exact fit.

New race-and-class combinations offer more ways to revisit a favorite class. Play an Undead Paladin, Dwarf Shaman, Gnome Priest, Human Hunter, Orc Mage, or Troll Warlock—options added to the original WoW lineup. A different pairing could be just the inspiration for your next character.

Racial abilities have also been updated, giving you another reason to consider how your race and class come together. Learn more in our article.

Progress Beyond Your Level

The Legacy System adds account-wide progression through challenges, Legacy Points, character-specific perks, and cosmetic rewards. Each character can spend points differently across Professions, Adventure, and Resourcefulness, so your interests can help shape how you use the system.

At launch, each character can spend up to 16 Legacy Points. You can reach that spending cap on a single character; creating alternate characters isn’t required. If you enjoy exploring different classes and professions, you have room to do so—but a favorite character can benefit, too.

Camping gives you another reason to pause along the road. Campsites and profession features bring players together out in the world, and sitting briefly by a campfire to become rested lets you receive campsite buffs before setting out again. Choose your spot with care: stopping to rest doesn’t put the dangers of Azeroth on hold.

Coordinate Before Character Creation

You choose a Ruleset rather than selecting from a traditional list of realms. Normal, PvP, Roleplay-PvP, and Roleplay offer different starting choices, with Hardcore planned to follow a little after launch.

Before creating characters with friends, agree on both your Ruleset and faction. Characters can group, join guilds, run dungeons, and raid together only within the same Ruleset and faction. It’s worth making that choice together so your first adventures begin in the same community. Players on PvP realms are restricted to one faction, so choose your allegiance wisely.

Room for Both, on Your Terms

As you settle into WoW: Forever, the modern game can stay part of your mix, too. Your World of Warcraft Subscription or Game Time gives you access to both, so an evening with friends here can sit alongside a favorite activity there.

Keep the plans you look forward to and see where the next session takes you. Whichever character you log in with, we’re glad to share Azeroth with you. Learn more about World of Warcraft: Forever here on the official news site.
